0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (6-3, on a two-game winning streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, on a four-game winning streak) in Minnesota's 10th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 132-126 win in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
